sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B model card
sources.evidence: Post-trained vision-language checkpoint; nominal language model size 9B; native context 262144; text, image and video input examples; thinking and tool-call deployment examples.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration with vision encoder and 32 dense text layers: three linear-attention layers per full-attention layer, FFN intermediate size 12288, and one MTP layer. No routed experts.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B repository and safetensors metadata
sources.evidence: Safetensors metadata reports 9653100528 BF16 plus 3840 F32 parameters, totaling 9653104368. Repository creation on February 27 is not public-release evidence.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B checkpoint tensor manifest
sources.evidence: Maps language-model, vision and MTP tensor names to four public shards; total stored tensor bytes 19306216416.

sources.title: Official Qwen repository release history
sources.evidence: Official repository, redirected from QwenLM/Qwen3.5, explicitly dates availability of Qwen3.5-9B, 4B, 2B and 0.8B to 2026-03-02.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B LICENSE

name.note: Display spelling of the official Qwen3.5-9B checkpoint.

developer.note: The official Qwen repository identifies Qwen team, Alibaba Group.

family.note: This exact checkpoint belongs to the Qwen3.5 series within Qwen.

release_date.note: Explicit exact-variant public-availability announcement; replaces February 23.

open_weights.note: Public post-trained checkpoint shards are downloadable.

license.note: SPDX spelling of the checkpoint license.

parameters_b.note: Complete checkpoint: 9653104368 stored parameters, including vision and MTP. Header sums: language model including LM head 8.953803264B, vision 0.456010480B, MTP 0.243290624B. The card labels only the language model nominally 9B.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active-per-token count is reported; dense architecture does not establish active equals total, especially with vision and MTP components.

architecture.note: Dense FFNs with hybrid Gated DeltaNet and gated full attention, plus vision encoder. Family-level MoE marketing in the card does not describe this variant.

context_window.note: Native token limit; the card separately describes configured extension to 1010000.

modalities.note: Exact-model examples cover all three inputs and text responses.

reasoning.note: Thinking is enabled by default and can be disabled.

tool_call.note: Exact-model server commands configure tool-call parsing and automatic tool choice.

description.value: Open-weight multimodal Qwen model with hybrid attention, optional thinking, and tool use.
description.note: Revised to identify multimodal capability and the documented hybrid-attention design without performance claims.

patch.description: Open-weight multimodal Qwen model with hybrid attention, optional thinking, and tool use.
patch.notes: 9B is the nominal language-model size. Complete released checkpoint contains 9.653104368B parameters: language model and LM head 8.953803264B, vision 0.456010480B, MTP 0.243290624B. Counts were summed from safetensors headers and match repository metadata. Active parameters are not separately reported. Native context is 262144; larger context requires extension configuration.

summary: Corrects release to March 2, 2026 and total from nominal 9B language-model label to 9.653104368B complete checkpoint. Adds Apache-2.0 and dense classification with hybrid attention; documents vision/MTP components and preserves unknown active count. Confirms native context, modalities, thinking and tool calls.
